## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2014-12-29: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.1 to initial S-1 with blank preamble date
- 2015-02-04: Up-C IPO closes; TRA executed at 85% sharing rate with SSE Holdings, LLC and the pre-IPO Members (Union Square Hospitality / Daniel Meyer affiliates and Green Equity Investors)

#### Tax Cuts and Jobs Act remeasurement

- 2017-12-27: FY2017 10-K records TRA liability write-down to $159M from $272M as the corporate tax rate cut reduces expected payouts

#### First material cash payment

- 2026-04-01: Q1 2026 10-Q reports $977K TRA payment (including interest), the largest single payment in the contract's life

## Explanation

Shake Shack Inc. executed a single Tax Receivable Agreement on February 4, 2015 at its Up-C IPO close, paying 85% of cumulative net realized tax benefits from Section 754 basis step-ups on Member redemptions and direct exchanges of SSE Holdings LLC Units. The contract has no amendments, restatements, or terminations across ~108 filings through Q1 2026. The TRA accrued substantial liability over the first decade (peaking at $272M in 2016, written down to $159M after the 2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, then climbing back to ~$247M by FY2025) but generated essentially no cash outflow until fiscal 2025, when $37K was paid; Q1 2026 then saw a $977K payment, marking a shift from accrual phase to active payment. See `contract_log.md` for the full payment history and the executed contract.
